scraping.title: CitiFX Pulse
scraping.visible_text: Demo About FAQs Awards Request Access Support Client Logins English LOG IN Need help? Chat About CitiFX Pulse We understand our clients FX needs go way beyond pricing. Modern FX management needs to service the full FX lifecycle. CitiFX Pulse embodies complete end-to-end electronic FX solutions for our global clients. CitiFX Pulse is a holistic and versatile web-based solution that combines both a workflow tool and a trading platform. CitiFX Pulse puts the network, technology, infrastructure and trading powers of the world’s leading corporate and institutional bank behind you, giving you complete control over your FX management, allowing you to hedge your exposures in 80+ markets, straight from and to your treasury management system (TMS) or enterprise resource planning (ERP). Speak to your CitiFX salesperson to find out more. CitiFX Pulse enables services such as connectivity to your treasury or trading ecosystems, market information and research, an integrated exposure management tool, post trade settlement, reconciliation and analysis tools, and many more services. We provide real-time 24-hour access to FX Spot, Forward, NDF and Swaps pricing in 500+ currencies complete with pre-trade and post-trade workflow tools all delivered through a seamless intuitive user-experience in 80+ countries. Recommended system requirements to run CitiFX Pulse CPU Intel or AMD processor with 64-bit support; Recommended 2.8 GHz or higher RAM 8 GB of free disk space Operating System Windows 10, Mac OS 12 or higher Networking 100 Mbps or higher, Ethernet card connected to the Internet or a VPN Screen Resolution 1920x1080 or higher, 32-bit colour Web Browser Microsoft Edge v88, Firefox v80, Safari v14 and Google Chrome v80 onwards. This website supports IPv6. Pre-Trade Before trading, you need simple tools to load your orders into a trading platform as well as information about the markets. CitiFX Pulse allows you to easily upload FX requests directly from your treasury ecosystem (ERP, TMS or Position Management Software). Its rich workflows offer, depending on the markets you need to trade, the possibility to submit trades with settlement instructions, FX payments or regulatory documents. CitiFX Pulse has news, research and alerts on tap, connecting you with everything from the published content of our world-class research team to the market commentary of our expert sales and trading teams. Accessing information this way helps you assess and act on the impact of market events to your business, from trading floor to trading platform in real-time. Execution When the time comes, control, accuracy and speed to market are critical. Pulse brings it all together to help you execute with confidence, enriched with everything from live rates and price requests to multi-leg dealing, benchmark execution, options and more. CitiFX Pulse allows you to gain single centralized view to all markets, onshore and offshore, using a single User ID. Your central Treasury may execute transactions acting on behalf of the local entity and facing onshore branch. If an oversight-only function is preferred, your central Treasury may simply monitor executions done by the subsidiaries Pulse execution module is configured to specific requirements of each market. User profiles may be configured to facilitate controls needs and offers controls on Access Types (Maker/ Checker /Read Only) Dealing Entity, Currency Pair, Side, Tenor, Notional, Time of Day, and IP Address Post-trade After trading, you need to settle your trades, make and track payments, split, allocate transactions or attach additional documentation. Pulse Post Trade Module allows you to do that and access a rich suite of other post trade services. Knowing the effect of your FX trades is crucial to developing a full understanding of their impact on your cashflow, positions and exposure to risk. Pulse gives you access to real-time and historical data, with up to seven years of transaction history. Customizing the reports you generate and downloading them for later uploading onto your treasury management or other system means you can view and evaluate all deals executed with Citi, regardless of their original execution method. 500+ Currency Pairs 80 Global Treasury Sites 40+ Awards since 2015 Award Winning Platform 2024 2023 2022 2021 2020 2019 2018 2017 2016 2015 2014 2013 2012 2011 Global Finance Best Bank Digital Platform Push your FX experience to new heights CitiFX Pulse - Designed with you in mind REQUEST ACCESS TO CITIFX PULSE © 2026 Citigroup Inc. Supported browsers For the best experience on chase.com make sure you're using the latest version of your favorite web browser. Apple Safari® Version 16.6 Download Safari® Opens overlay Google Chrome® Version 130 Download Chrome® Opens overlay Microsoft Edge® Version 132 Download Edge® Opens overlay Mozilla Firefox® Version 128 Download Firefox® Opens overlay Important notes: We don't support browsers in Compatibility Mode (this only applies to Microsoft Edge). General requirements To access Chase.com effectively, you will need: Broadband internet access: A stable and fast internet connection is essential for optimal performance. Encryption support: Your browser must support encryption to ensure secure transactions. Cookies: These must be enabled to enhance functionality and security. See our Online Privacy Policy to learn why we use cookies. Required operating systems Make sure your device uses one of the following operating systems: Windows: Windows 10 and higher. Macintosh: macOS 11 Big Sur and higher. Troubleshooting tips If you encounter issues while using Chase.com, consider the following: Verify that your browser is on the supported list and is a stable, officially released version. Ensure no third-party browser extensions or plug-ins are interfering with your browsing experience. Check that your cookies are enabled. scraping.visible_text: × Important Information The Positive Pay System (PPS) is a tool designed to protect cheque transactions from probable fraud. The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has announced the introduction of the Positive Pay System for the Cheque Truncation System (CTS). The concept of the Positive Pay System involves a process of reconfirming key details of large value cheques. Under this process, the issuer of the cheque shall submit, through channels like mobile banking app (ai1), internet banking, WhatsApp Banking, Branch Channel etc., certain details of that cheque such as Cheque Number, Cheque Date, Amount, Payee’s Name, and MICR Code. These details are cross-checked when the cheque is presented through CTS Clearing. Any mismatch in the details submitted by the customer and the cheque received in clearing shall make the cheque liable for dishonour. All our esteemed customers are requested to note that while issuing cheques for amounts of ₹5,00,000/- (Rupees Five Lakhs Only) and above, it is mandatory to register cheque details under the Positive Pay System. In case the cheque details are not submitted to PPS, such cheques shall be liable to be dishonoured and returned to the presenting banker. scraping.title: HDFC Online Deposit Login
scraping.visible_text: Login With OTP Important note: · The deposits in the Bank are insured with DICGC for an amount of Rs.5 Lakhs (Principal + Interest) per depositor · In terms of Reserve Bank of India Directives, Interest will be calculated at quarterly intervals on Term Deposits and payable at the rate decided by the bank depending upon the period of deposits. In case of Monthly Deposit Scheme, the interest will be calculated for the quarter and paid monthly at discounted value. · HDFC Bank computes interest based on the actual number of days in a year. In case, the Deposit is spread over a leap and a non-leap year, the interest is calculated based on the number of days i.e., 366 days in a leap year & 365 days in a non leap year. · In the absence of any maturity instruction or in case of auto renewal the deposit will be renewed for a period equal to that of the original deposit at the prevailing rate on the date of renewal · Maturity amount for deposits would vary to the extent of tax and compounding effect on tax for the period subsequent of deduction till maturity and also due to rounding off (to the extent of 50 paise in each F.Y.) · Effective Deposit Date will be based on fund received in HDFC Bank account. · In case of premature closure of Fixed Deposit (including sweep in / partial closure) the interest rate will be 1.00% below of the lower of either – 1) the contracted rate or 2) the applicable rate for the period the deposit has remained with the bank, whichever is lower. · In Case of premature withdrawal of the fixed deposit based on depositor’s instructions or the instructions of all the joint depositors in the case of joint deposit, the bank has the right to recover interest already paid or the penalty, if any, from the proceeds of the fixed deposit in accordance with prevailing regulations of the bank and the Reserve Bank of India. · To know more about HDFC Bank products/ prevailing interest rates /any query/ suggestion/ feedback, please visit our branch, bank website www.hdfc.bank.in or you may write to support@hdfcbank.com.
